name: Future Perfect
summaryPt: Ação que estará concluída antes de um momento futuro.

meaningUses.pt: Ação concluída antes de um momento futuro
meaningUses.en: By 6 p.m., I will have finished my work.
meaningUses.enPt: Até às 18h, terei terminado meu trabalho.
Até 2030, ela já terá se formado.

formation.pattern: I will have finished — she will have gone

examples.en: I won't have finished by then.

formation.pt: Yes, + pronome + will. No, + pronome + won't.
formation.pattern: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.

examples.en: A: Will you have finished? B: Yes, I will.
examples.pt: A: Você terá terminado? B: Sim.

subjectAgreement.pt: A mesma forma (will have) para todas as pessoas.
subjectAgreement.example: I will have finished. She will have finished. They will have finished.

pronunciation.pt: will have em fala rápida → 'll have /aɪl hæv/.

commonErrors.pt: Usar verbo no passado em vez do particípio

contrast.pt: Future perfect = concluído antes de um momento. Future continuous = em andamento num momento.
contrast.en: By 6, I will have finished. (concluído) — At 6, I will be working. (em andamento)
contrast.enPt: Até às 6, terei terminado. — Às 6, estarei trabalhando.

examples.en: By 6 p.m., I will have finished my work.
examples.pt: Até às 18h, terei terminado meu trabalho.

examples.en: I won't have finished by then.

examples.pt: Até 2030, ela já terá se formado.

guidedPractice.full: I won't have finished by then.

guidedPractice.pt: Até 2030, ela já terá se formado.

guidedPractice.prompt: By the time you arrive, I ___ have cooked dinner.
guidedPractice.full: By the time you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.
guidedPractice.pt: Quando você chegar, terei cozinhado o jantar.
guidedPractice.explanation: Concluído antes de um momento → will have + particípio.

guidedPractice.prompt: A: Will you have finished? B: Yes, I ___.
guidedPractice.full: A: Will you have finished? B: Yes, I will.
guidedPractice.pt: A: Você terá terminado? B: Sim.

guidedPractice.full: By noon, she will have left.
guidedPractice.pt: Até ao meio-dia, ela terá saído.

reviewQuiz.prompt: By 6, I will ___ finished my work.
reviewQuiz.full: By 6, I will have finished my work.
reviewQuiz.pt: Até às 6, terei terminado meu trabalho.

reviewQuiz.full: She will have gone by then.
I won't have finished by then.

reviewQuiz.prompt: By the time you arrive, I will have ___ (finish).
reviewQuiz.full: By the time you arrive, I will have finished.

reviewQuiz.prompt: By 2030, they ___ have built the new school.
reviewQuiz.full: By 2030, they will have built the new school.
reviewQuiz.pt: Até 2030, eles terão construído a nova escola.
reviewQuiz.explanation: Concluído antes de um momento → will have + particípio.

reviewQuiz.prompt: A: Will she have finished? B: No, she ___.
reviewQuiz.full: A: Will she have finished? B: No, she won't.
reviewQuiz.pt: A: Ela terá terminado? B: Não.
reviewQuiz.explanation: Resposta curta negativa: No, she won't.

reviewQuiz.prompt: By the weekend, I will have ___ (write) the report.
reviewQuiz.full: By the weekend, I will have written the report.
reviewQuiz.pt: Até o fim de semana, terei escrito o relatório.

reviewQuiz.prompt: By the time you wake up, I ___ have left.
reviewQuiz.full: By the time you wake up, I will have left.
reviewQuiz.pt: Quando você acordar, já terei saído.
reviewQuiz.explanation: By the time + futuro → will have + particípio.
